::: {.uni-intro}
Tehran's oldest technical university, where our matrix-library assignment came from — an AP1400-2 homework from Spring 2022.
:::

> 德黑兰最古老的理工院校，我们的矩阵库作业就来自这里——2022 年春季的 AP1400-2 作业。

## Why it matters <span class='zh-inline'>(为何重要)</span>

Amirkabir built the country's first computer-engineering PhD programme; its AP1400 assignments carry that rigor forward.

> Amirkabir 建立了伊朗首个计算机工程博士项目，AP1400 作业延续了这份严谨。

## Background <span class='zh-inline'>(背景)</span>

A public technological university in Tehran, founded in 1958 as Tehran Polytechnic (some sources trace roots to a 1928 academy), renamed after Amir Kabir in 1979. Its Computer Engineering Department began teaching in 1988.

> 德黑兰的公立理工院校，1958 年以“德黑兰理工学院”之名成立（部分资料追溯到 1928 年的技术学校），1979 年以 Amir Kabir 命名。计算机工程系 1988 年开始招生授课。

| Person | Connection to computing |
|:--|:--|
| Jalal Al-e-Ahmad | influential Iranian writer and intellectual among its alumni |
| Mohammad Reza Meybodi | Professor Emeritus of Computer Engineering. The department established Iran's first computer-engineering PhD programme in 2002 |

> **Jalal Al-e-Ahmad** — 该校校友，伊朗有影响力的作家与知识分子。**Mohammad Reza Meybodi** — 计算机工程荣休教授。该系于 2002 年设立伊朗首个计算机工程博士项目。
